## Evidence

- [ ] Relevant tests pass; list commands and important scenarios below.
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, test, build, dependency audit, and secret scan pass when applicable.

## Impact assessment

- [ ] Security/privacy: data classification, authorization, secrets, audit events, and abuse/failure paths reviewed.
- [ ] Observability: logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, or alerts updated where needed.
- [ ] UI/UX: WCAG 2.2 AA, responsive behavior, and loading/empty/error/success states reviewed; attach evidence for user-facing changes.
- [ ] Documentation and task register updated where needed.

## Governance and release

- [ ] ADR linked for material architecture, data, security, provider, deployment, or API-contract decisions; otherwise state why one is not required.
- [ ] Migration, rollout, and rollback/compensating-change plan included when applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, production data, or sensitive payloads were added to source, logs, fixtures, or screenshots.
